cohort: The study included 6,989 livebirths recorded by the Health and Demographic Surveillance System (HDSS) from selected slums in and around Dhaka city during 2016-2018.
finding: Preterm birth significantly contributed to neonatal deaths, accounting for 39.6% of such deaths, and very preterm neonates had 8.66 times higher odds of neonatal mortality compared to term neonates.
gest_age: Babies born at various gestational ages, categorized as very preterm (28-31 weeks), moderate preterm (32-33 weeks), late preterm (34-36 weeks), and term (>=37 weeks).
